This two-hour community meeting will be hosted virtually and is open to all Astrophysics community members, academia, and the public. During the Town Hall, NASA Astrophysics leadership will provide division updates, mission highlights, and discuss our efforts supporting the agency’s Faster to Science initiative. The focus for this meeting will be to discuss the strategic vision and mission for the division, including current initiatives and future plans, and address questions from the community. Individuals may submit questions prior to and during the Town Hall using the link below. We encourage you to submit your questions by Nov. 12, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. ET, to ensure they are considered during the meeting. We encourage your participation!
